title: MediaSourceConfig

allOf.description: The AWS Secrets Manager ARN for the username and password of the camera, or a local media file location.

The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) type. The FILE_URI value can be used to stream local media files.

Preview only supports the RTSP_URI media source URI format .

description: The configuration details that consist of the credentials required (MediaUriSecretArn and MediaUriType) to access the media files that are streamed to the camera.
